content: “He Yehoba siba ge aatena iyaka i pek Besaleli ge Oholiyab avaliyau totuwalali enuna al elal limi bwabwalena ana taltal gegewena hi atena. Inoke tuwalali o nihi ginol ni ola Yehoba wana baaba.”
Gamagal wali Mulolu I Bwata Hot
Yaka Besaleli ge Oholiyab avaliyau totuwalali bolo Yehoba aatena i pek elal ge hi yaliyaya tuwalali kaiwena, Mosese i yogaagil hi nok elana.
Inoke mulolu gegewena bolo Isileli hi pwatanim limi bwabwalena ana taltal kaiwena, Mosese i bugul pek elal. Yaa Isileli heliya iyoho ya mweluluga maisena ge maisena hi nemnem wali mulolu hi teliteli.
Yaka bolo limi bwabwalena hi taltal tuwalali hi paveyaho ga,
ge hi na hi baek Mosese elana hi ba, “Mulolu bolo gamagal hi pwatanim i bwata lake te tuwalali toto Yehoba i ba elala ta ginol.”

Inoke Mosese i ba, “Bolau ge yowau bahi bugul etega al nihi lolovivina-an ge nihi mumulolu-an limi bwabwalena kaiwena.” Yaka wana baaba hi palelu abaholaviya. Inoke gamagal nige al bugul etega hi pwapwatanim,
kaiwena toto iyaka hi pwatanim, tuwalali gegewena tage nihi ginol ana luvi i bwata lake.
Petupatupa Limena ana Ginol Hi Ginol
